name: helper-scaffold-exports
goal: Every generated package export resolves to an emitted scaffold; pure helper generators and CLI projects retain coherent public imports

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Hosted Full check on8442578 found the pure helper scaffold still exported the old Helper class filename. Same-name util/helper generation also produced duplicate SDK bindings.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Standard pieces tests checked emitted paths but not their export plans. Strengthened all-scaffold export coherence and existing idempotent export/CLI library checks; retained same requested PublishPost name and compilation.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red 9f780528988baf11061602e292c3059dc595220aadf1bd22f3f90acb3c0a7cd9 reproduces missing emitted export and collision on committed test-only revision e963f65ad4cc6d14a554126c8d3f912c7cb9df4b.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Map helper SDK exports to the actual camelCase function file, preserve existing bindings with a qualified colliding helper export, and use the existing standard scaffold/export/CLI tests as guards.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Updated pieceExportPlans and helper export appending; documented naming contract and reviewed original helper/service migration ledgers without replacing their original records.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable green 187817522d400a4206abc0e5d60ad547feb4fe447cdc133f67ab43e6d92b97ba passes the unchanged command/tests/environment from red;4 selected assertions including the original same-name generated-library full check pass.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated committed broken snapshot names the original missing Helper class export and fails the export-coherence guard; the repaired snapshot restores it and passes the same checks. Records retain both command outputs.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Focused SDK coherence/idempotence and existing lib CLI compilation pass; root88 cases/types/lint/audit and Reports697 unit tests pass. Full CLI/native suites remain user-deferred; UI delivery is tracked by the helper-source-folders loop and combined main catalog.
